sources.snippet: Model Zoo SemanticKITTI We share the pretrained models for MinkowskiNets, our manually designed SPVCNN models and also SPVNAS models found by our 3D-NAS pipeline. All the pretrained models are available in the model zoo. Currently, we release the models trained on sequences 00-07 and 09-10 and evaluated on sequence 08.

sources.title: torch-pointcloud (PyTorch PointCloud) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PyTorch PointCloud (torch-pointcloud) is a collection of point cloud models, layers, utilities, datasets, transforms, and reference training / benchmarking scripts that aim to reproduce SOTA models and help researchers and engineers reuse common layers. Find all the torch-pointcloud models here.

sources.title: [2007.16100] Searching Efficient 3D Architectures with Sparse Point ...
sources.snippet: Experimental results validate that the resulting SPVNAS model is fast and accurate: it outperforms the state-of-the-art MinkowskiNet by 3.3%, ranking 1st on the competitive SemanticKITTI leaderboard. It also achieves 8x computation reduction and 3x measured speedup over MinkowskiNet with higher accuracy.
